event_time_equation: t_event = t_floor + delta_voice_shape + delta_coupling + delta_gesture + delta_recovery
cross_scale_constraint: local event changes may vary inside an edit horizon while at least one explicitly selected identity anchor remains observable

performance_operations.meaning: maintain a reference layer while other relations change
move one voice before or after another without shifting every voice equally
change one voice's subdivision family while preserving a perceptible reference
remove a voice while retaining its relational trace in the remaining field
turn phase conflict or an error into the next playable relation instead of rewinding
return only the released intervention toward the current reference, not every layer to a loop start
explicitly choose what must remain recognizable while another scale changes
change events inside a chosen edit horizon without automatically changing the selected identity anchor
record the current performance only after an explicit user action; recording does not start autonomous playback
use an explicitly selected recorded observation to inform the next live action without letting the system choose a finished result

separation_rules: do not equate J Dilla's recorded microtiming with Aphex Twin's editing or one-take workflow
do not classify Autechre as rules and Aphex Twin as hand editing without work-level evidence
do not treat a one-take recording as proof of unprepared improvisation
do not treat edition identity, performance identity and event timing as one variable
anti_patterns: one touch equals one independent completed track
automatic rewind to a stored loop start
automatic recording or playback after release
automatic selection of the best take
adding voices whenever touch count increases
artist-branded presets as a substitute for relations
falsification_tests: remove the selected identity anchor while preserving local event statistics and test whether continuity is unchanged
preserve the identity anchor while changing local event order and test whether continuity survives
compare explicit snapshot and automatic loop playback for perceived live agency
compare event-level recovery with phrase-level reentry after the same interruption
implementation_boundary: research model only; no product path, integration decision, listening result or artist-style reproduction claim changed
